categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches descriptor construction in src/script/descriptor.{cpp,h} to support multisig wallet setup flows (#35645), falling under descriptor management.
categories.rationale: Adds programmatic multisig descriptor construction and validation to eliminate manual descriptor string interpolation during wallet setup (#35645). The helper introduces validation against duplicate keys and invalid thresholds, but as standalone helper code without in-tree callers it is reasonably deferrable.
